4168e873584ae50a12733262026c007dce18ec89	2026-09-04T13:13:26+08:00	packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds
69203710b8582c489f420ef53a769cc6077c250b	2026-08-08T12:01:28+09:00	build(boost): refine --as-needed linker flag placement and apply JAM rules
f7e388c3596c92d54ac2df54b4c4b611a3fbda0d	2026-07-29T09:08:28+09:00	build(boost): apply -Wl,--as-needed linker option

packaging/boost.spec          | 32 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++-
 tools/build/src/tools/gcc.jam |  4 ++--
 2 files changed, 33 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/packaging/boost.spec b/packaging/boost.spec
index 71adc9a86..6c7fc4ed7 100644
--- a/packaging/boost.spec
+++ b/packaging/boost.spec
@@ -14,6 +14,12 @@
 
 %define disable_long_double 0
 
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_with_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
+
 %define boost_libs1 boost-date-time boost-filesystem boost-graph boost-iostreams boost-math boost-test
 %define boost_libs2 boost-program-options boost-python3 boost-serialization boost-system boost-thread
 %define boost_libs3 boost-wave boost-url boost-regex boost-contract boost-random boost-chrono boost-locale
@@ -76,6 +82,10 @@ BuildRequires:  libicu-devel
 BuildRequires:  pkgconfig(python3)
 BuildRequires:  xz
 BuildRequires:  fdupes
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+BuildRequires:  libc++-devel
+BuildRequires:  libc++abi-devel
+%endif
 
 %define _docdir %{_datadir}/doc/packages/boost-%{version}
 
@@ -101,7 +111,11 @@ see the boost-doc package.
 Summary:        Development package for Boost C++
 Group:          Development/Libraries/C and C++
 Requires:       %{all_libs}
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+Requires:       libc++-devel
+%else
 Requires:       libstdc++-devel
+%endif
 
 %description    devel
 This package contains all that is needed to develop/compile
@@ -428,6 +442,7 @@ find . -name \*.orig -exec rm {} +
 
 %build
 CC="%{__cc}"
+export LDFLAGS="-Wl,--as-needed ${LDFLAGS}"
 %ifarch %arm
 CFLAGS="${CFLAGS} -Wp,-D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64"
 CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -Wp,-D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64"
@@ -459,6 +474,11 @@ export EXPAT_INCLUDE=/usr/include EXPAT_LIBPATH=%{_libdir}
 export PYTHON_FLAGS
 LIBRARIES_FLAGS=--with-libraries=all
 
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++"
+LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -stdlib=libc++ -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed"
+%endif
+
 %if !%{build_context}
 # coroutine/coroutine2 depend on context
 LIBRARIES_FLAGS="${LIBRARIES_FLAGS} --without-libraries=context,coroutine"
@@ -475,6 +495,11 @@ touch user-config.jam
 # Read shared build instructions
 . ./.build
 
+# Keep the exact Boost.Build properties for the separate install scriptlet.
+printf '%s\n' "$CFLAGS" > .boost-cflags
+printf '%s\n' "$CXXFLAGS" > .boost-cxxflags
+printf '%s\n' "$LDFLAGS" > .boost-linkflags
+
 %if %build_mpi
 # Set PATH, MANPATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH for mpi
 . /var/mpi-selector/data/$(rpm --qf "%{NAME}-%{VERSION}" -q openmpi).sh
@@ -546,6 +571,9 @@ install -D -m 644 %{testlogfile} $RPM_BUILD_ROOT%{_datadir}/boosttestsuite.log
 
 # Read shared build instructions
 . ./.build
+CFLAGS=$(cat .boost-cflags)
+CXXFLAGS=$(cat .boost-cxxflags)
+LDFLAGS=$(cat .boost-linkflags)
 
 %if %build_mpi
 # Set PATH, MANPATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH for mpi
@@ -555,7 +583,9 @@ install -D -m 644 %{testlogfile} $RPM_BUILD_ROOT%{_datadir}/boosttestsuite.log
 ./b2 install %{?_smp_mflags} \
     --prefix=%{buildroot}%{_prefix} --exec-prefix=%{buildroot}%{_bindir} \
     --libdir=%{buildroot}%{_libdir} --includedir=%{buildroot}%{_includedir} \
-    --user-config=./user-config.jam target-os=unix
+    --user-config=./user-config.jam ${CFLAGS:+cflags="$CFLAGS"} \
+    ${CXXFLAGS:+cxxflags="$CXXFLAGS"} ${LDFLAGS:+linkflags="$LDFLAGS"} \
+    target-os=unix
 
 # do not install the python module - as long as noone needs it, it requires more fixes
 # see https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=801534 for details

    packaging: select libc++ for Clang toolchain builds
    
    Use libc++ only when the Base Toolchain selector resolves to Clang.
